subject: Post-demo recap: Pellion token profile and incentive asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex@pellion.ai>, Maria Gonzales <maria@pellion.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: Pellion token profile and incentive asks

Hi Alex / Maria —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the deep dive into the Pellion ingestion + summarization flows. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary of usage profile you shared:
- Pilot (Q3): ~10M tokens / month (inference heavy, 90% generation).
- Ramp (Q4–Q1): 30–50M tokens / month as you add multi-tenant summarization.
- Long-term target: 100M+ tokens / month in year two, depending on model choices and caching.

Budget / unit-econ ask:
- You indicated a target blended cost of roughly $1,200–$1,500 per 1M tokens to hit your unit-econ goals and stay within your product margin band.
- Procurement prefers a committed-use path (3–12 month ramps) + an initial startup incentive to reduce cash burn during pilot.

Requests we want to confirm from Redwood: 
1) Startup program: credit or rebate for first 3–6 months (helps the pilot runway).
2) Committed-use discounts: banded discounts for 3/6/12 month commitments; target is ~10–25% off list depending on length and volume.
3) Multi-year incentive: if Pellion is willing to go 2-year committed use, any additional rebate structure or price-step guarantees.

Can you confirm the internal approval path/time for a starter credit (we'd need sign-off before July 1 procurement window) and a ballpark committed-use discount matrix we can present to your CFO? If you can send a single preferred target $/1M token number (e.g., $1,200) for a 6-month pilot commitment, that will help speed the legal/finance conversation.

Attached: pellion-demo-notes.pdf (short summary of call).

Next steps: I'll pull a few pricing scenarios with Marissa and Priyom and get back by tomorrow AM PT with a recommended starter credit + committed bands. Also happy to set a 30-min pricing walkthrough with finance if you want to loop them in.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

---
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Alex Torres <alex@pellion.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: Pellion token profile and incentive asks

Ben —

Thanks for the writeup, that aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 
- Target: CFO wants a firm target $/1M tokens we can put in the vendor comparison (they asked for a single line item to compare against other providers). If you have a one-line firm price for a 6-month pilot at ~10M/mo, that would be ideal.
- Startup credit timing: procurement needs to know if credits get applied to the invoice immediately or as a rebate after invoice.
- Committed bands: we prefer a 6-month preferred, 12-month stretch. Can you confirm the delta between those two (ballpark percent)?

Procurement timeline: we'd like to lock something before July 1 so we can align the pilot start with Q3 engineering sprints.

If it helps, we can schedule a quick call with our head of finance next week.

Cheers,
Alex
CTO, Pellion Labs
alex@pellion.ai

Folks — forwarding Pellion's ask (see below). High level: they want a starter credit for pilot + a committed-use discount matrix for 6 vs 12 months. Procurement wants a single comparison price for our bid.

Key asks to handle: 
- Starter credit: they need to know if the credit is applied up-front on invoice or as a post-invoice rebate. Recommend providing a 60% applied-up-front credit cap (e.g., $5k starter credit applied over first 2 invoices) to keep churn risk low.
- Committed-use bands: ballpark bands we should offer to be competitive vs hyperscaler and other LLM vendors. Aim to hit their target $1,200/1M for the 6-month pilot if possible.
- Multi-year: if we consolidate, what additional rebate or price floor guarantee can we offer for 2-year commitments.

Can you please send back 2–3 scenarios (conservative / baseline / aggressive) with exact $/1M numbers and any required minimums by tomorrow AM? I'll present to Alex and schedule the finance call if they want it.

Attachment: pellion-pricing-ask-brief.txt

Thanks —
Ben

Ben —

Draft scenarios attached (pricing-scenarios.xlsx). Quick summary of recommended position: 

Starter credit:
- Approved: $5,000 starter credit applied across first two invoices (applies as an upfront invoice credit, not rebate). Starter-credit terms attached in starter-credit-offer.pdf.

Committed-use discounts (banded) — baseline / suggested: 
- 3 month commit (min 8M/mo): 7% off list; implied $/1M = $1,650 (list $1,775).
- 6 month commit (min 10M/mo): 15% off list; implied $/1M = $1,510 (list $1,775).
- 12 month commit (min 20M/mo): 25% off list; implied $/1M = $1,331 (list $1,775).

Multi-year (2 year) incentive:
- Additional 5% rebate at renewal if year-1 volume >= committed baseline. We can structure as a year-end credit.

Recommended play for Pellion: offer the 6 month pilot at an effective $/1M of $1,400–1,450 (after applying starter credit amortized across pilot) to get them comfortable with the number and keep room for expansion pricing in Q4. Finance will require a PO and standard net-30 invoicing; legal will need to sign the commitment SOW (I can draft).

Next steps: Ben, if you want I can package the pricing-scenarios.xlsx + starter-credit-offer.pdf and a short SOW template — then you can share with Pellion and schedule the 15-min finance sync.

Marissa Cole
